items.title: Sheila Jordan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Middleburgh, New York, May 11, 2002
items.q: I love Kenny Barron, he’s just so wonderful. We worked — I have a few albums with him.

ctx.x: But just recently I did listen to Blue Note, the Blue Note recording. Because everybody was telling me, giving me really beautiful compliments on it, and I thought gee, what’s the big deal? I don’t — how come I don’t hear it? I don’t hear that. That doesn’t sound good to me. I mean I remember how I felt when I did it, but what happens is I start listening to it and I say, as most creative musicians, oh that could have gone here, and this could have gone there. You know I can’t just sit and enjoy it. Somebody else…
